title: phlox carolina var. angusta
intro: Phlox carolina var. angusta, commonly known as the Narrow-leaf Phlox, is a perennial plant native to the southeastern United States, characterized by its pink, purple, or white flowers and narrow, lance-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Phlox carolina var. angusta include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and act as a natural antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and sedative effects, which may help to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Phlox carolina var. angusta include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
